notes: Pins the in-process DeepSeek Harness /clear rotation. The combined durable fixture must contain exactly two distinct session headers for one cwd, exact tool-free replies on both sides, and no tool call. The lifecycle requires the first UUID's turn, a new ready UUID, same-PID retirement of the first row, and the second UUID's turn.

transcript_assertions.name: two reset sessions share one cwd

text: The first real DSH UUID session appears in ready after TUI launch
The exact pre-reset prompt drives the first UUID from ready to working
The first UUID binds to the process holding its session.lock
The completed pre-reset turn returns the first UUID to ready
After /clear, a distinct DSH UUID appears in ready before the second prompt
The post-reset UUID binds to the live TUI process through its new session.lock
The same-PID cleanup removes the pre-reset UUID from the dashboard after the new UUID binds
The exact post-reset prompt drives only the new UUID from ready to working
The completed post-reset turn returns the new UUID to ready as the final live state
